title.narrative: Community stabilization for conflict-affected communities in northern Mo

description.narrative:
Agreement to support IOMs work with community stabilization and combatting violent extremism in Northern Mozambique (Niassa, Cabo Delgado and Nampula), including support to communities in the form of small grants, community revitalization projects, peace clubs, as well as reintegration of former combattants.
For six years, the province of Cabo Delgado in northern Mozambique has experienced attacks by armed groups affiliated with the Islamic State causing over 700,000 people to be internally displaced and leaving many communities affected by loss, destruction, as well as negative economic and social impact. The insecurity in northern Mozambique is multi-faceted with many drivers including perceptions of historical marginalization and lack of economic opportunities. This project will seek to promote community stabilization and preventing violent extremism in Northern Mozambique, particularly in communities affected by conflict with a specific focus on youth, women and girls.
In pursuit of this objective, IOM will build upon its previous work supporting community-led conflict prevention and creating a conducive environment for communities to live peaceful and productive lives through income generation activities, school-based peace clubs, community-based projects prioritized by communities and support to the Government of Mozambique to discuss mechanisms and frameworks for reintegration of former and eligible non-state armed group (NSAG) members.
IOM will conduct flexible, ongoing, context specific research, and allow this research to drive interventions in the northern, eastern and southern districts of Cabo Delgado, with a potential to expand to the province of Nampula and Niassa.
